chapter: Louis Dumaine and Kid Rene bands
title: Louis Dumaine band: Gabriel's music library and its members
summary: Gabriel owned the sheet music so he was hired for the Dumaine band; he names the sidemen and describes the saxophone audition, his brothers and Percy in Detroit.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
